claims: Uber offers fully autonomous, driverless rides through partnerships, most notably with Waymo in Phoenix, Austin, and Atlanta.
Users can select the Waymo option in the Uber app.
Waymo vehicles are driverless, all-electric Jaguar I-PACEs.
Jaguar I-PACE features 360-degree cameras and sensors for navigation.
Self-driving Ubers are currently available in Phoenix, Austin, and Atlanta.
In the Uber app, users may be matched with a Waymo.
Users can set preferences in the Uber app to prioritize autonomous vehicles.
Self-driving cars operate without a human driver.
Self-driving cars are equipped with lidar, radar, and cameras for safety.
A 24/7 helpline is accessible via the Uber app.
Waymo is the primary partner providing fully autonomous, self-driving cars.
Autonomous rides are live in Austin, TX and Atlanta, GA.
As of early 2026, Uber continues to integrate autonomous technology into its platform.
On Oct 26, 2023, Uber announced that users in Phoenix will be able to ride in a fully autonomous car.
CBS Sunday Morning stated on May 11, 2025 that every year 1.2 million people die in car accidents.
